description.text: ◎Directly under the Ministry of Education ◎Fully professional and experienced teaching team, passionate about Chinese language education and familiar with the characteristics of overseas students ◎High scholarship availability ◎Various Courses ◎High Quality Facilities ,Personalized services ◎Excellent location: East campus near the embassy area,CBD business circle , Tian’ an men Square, the Forbidden City and other famous attractions. West campus is located in the middle of peer universities with great culture atmosphere. ◎Superior facilities, thoughtful teaching and Living Services efficient transportation and easy life, Hotels, supermarkets, hospitals, subway, bus stops with easy access.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Program at Beijing University of Chemical Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2291 USD/per year ￥ 16500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form (template) 2. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid passport in color. 3. A clearly scanned copy of the high school graduation certificate. 4. A scanned copy of the high school academic transcript for the entire high school period. 5. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (HSK; IELTS, TOEFL, Duolinguo, SAT, GRE and other proofs of English proficiency) 6. Physical Examination Certificate issued within the last 6 months 7. Non-criminal record certificate issued within last 5 months List of other application materials for foreign students in China: 1. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid visa in color 2. Letter of good conduct 3. Study certificate

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be citizens of nations other than China and in good health condition. 2.Applicants should at least hold a high school diploma and be not older than 50; 3.Applicants should have no any illegal records in China. ◎Those who pass the final examination will be issued with the "certificate of Graduation" by Chinese language training Beijing University of Chemical Technology. ◎Those who failed the final examination or absent from the final examination will be issued with the "proof of study" by Chinese language training Beijing University of Chemical Technology
